model.title: Stopping Foreign Influence in Elections Act of 2026
model.meta: Ways and Means Committee · Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would amend tax law to impose penalties on political committees that accept contributions from foreign sources, aiming to strengthen protections against foreign money influencing U.S. elections.
